clue.text: TSE, say, playing for the Barbarians for example

definitions.meaning: TSE is one half of the African insect name tsetse

definitions.text: playing for the Barbarians for example
definitions.meaning: the Barbarians are a famous invitational rugby side, and this is a position one plays there

explanation.surface: Someone with the initials TSE turns out for a celebrated rugby team.
explanation.walkthrough: TSE is half of TSETSE, the African fly, so it is a 'fly half'. A fly-half is also a key rugby position, and the Barbarians are a famous invitational British rugby club.
explanation.definitionFit: A rugby half-back who plays behind the scrum is called this, and the insect reading makes the joke.

clue.text: Brush the grass

definitions.meaning: a brush is the bushy tail of a fox in hunting language
a meadow grass with bushy flower spikes bears this name

explanation.definitionFit: Hunting folk call the fox's bushy rear appendage its brush, and a cylindrical-headed meadow plant shares the name.

clue.text: Revolution from January to December?

parts.note: the Earth's orbit of the sun from the start to the end of the calendar takes twelve months, suggesting something lasting all through the calendar

explanation.surface: A political uprising that lasts the whole calendar.
explanation.walkthrough: Revolution looks political, but here it is the Earth's trip round the sun, which runs January to December.
explanation.definitionFit: Something available throughout all twelve months is described this way, like one full orbit.

clue.text: Crime of churchman short of cash

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the cash letter is taken away from the churchman

parts.note: a parson is a parish clergyman
P stands for penny, a small coin of cash

explanation.surface: A clergyman's offence when he is low on funds.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately setting fire to property is a criminal offence.

clue.text: Gun deal is off causing outburst

parts.note: a fusil is an old light flintlock musket

indicators.note: off means wrong or not right, so the letters of deal are rearranged

explanation.surface: An arms sale is cancelled and provokes an angry outburst.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gun' looks like the start of an arms deal, but it is the old musket; 'off' is the anagram signal on the word deal, and 'is' and 'causing' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A fusillade is a burst of gunfire, used figuratively for a barrage of words.

clue.text: Told how to get there in this?

definitions.text: Told how to get there in this?

indicators.note: told means spoken out, so the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.words: how to get there in this
parts.note: travelling in this aircraft, you would get there by plane

explanation.surface: Someone asks how to make a journey and is given the answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Told' signals a homophone: 'by plane' sounds like the two-winged aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft with two pairs of wings stacked one above the other is a mode of air travel.

clue.text: Coffee — pot for four at table

definitions.meaning: coffee as a colour is a mid ... shade
in snooker, potting the ball of this colour scores four points

explanation.walkthrough: Snooker is a cue game popular in Britain; the coloured balls carry set values, and this one is worth four.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffee is a shade of this colour, and the snooker ball of this colour is worth four points when potted.

clue.text: Art capable of improving a good deal?

definitions.text: Art capable of improving a good deal?

parts.words: Art capable of improving a good deal?
parts.note: the craft of burning designs into wood, read as work at the card game where a good deal of the cards matters

explanation.surface: An art form that can enhance things considerably.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a good deal' looks like 'a lot', but is a hand dealt at cards; the art is burning patterns into wood with a hot poker.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorating wood or leather by scorching designs with a heated rod is a traditional craft.

clue.text: An area of activity for the expert

parts.note: an gives the article A
DEPT is short for department, a field of activity

explanation.surface: A domain in which a specialist works.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone highly skilled in a field is a master or adept.

clue.text: Bridge manoeuvre bringing down the curtain

definitions.meaning: in the card game bridge, a late tactic forcing an opponent to lead to your advantage
bringing down the curtain on stage finishes the drama

explanation.definitionFit: A card-game tactic near the last tricks, and literally finishing a theatrical performance.

clue.text: Cross beams in pictures of interiors

parts.note: a cross is the letter X
beams of light are rays

explanation.surface: Intersecting beams of light inside a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiographs are images showing the inside of the body.

clue.text: Shake up by master being rough at the top

parts.note: to shock someone is to shake them up
a head is a headmaster or master of a school

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster rattles someone and is harsh at senior level.
explanation.definitionFit: A person with a thick shaggy mass of hair has a tousled crown.

clue.text: It makes the heart beat faster and, in Lear, is destructive

definitions.text: It makes the heart beat faster

indicators.note: destructive suggests something broken up, so these letters are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A stimulant that quickens the pulse plays havoc in Shakespeare's King Lear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destructive' rearranges the letters of AND, IN and LEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A hormone released under stress speeds up the pulse.

clue.text: Creature from a later grouping

indicators.note: grouping means the letters of later are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: An animal appears from a subsequent arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: The honey badger, an African animal, is also known by this name.

clue.text: Bear found headless in the water

indicators.note: headless means the first letter of the bear constellation is removed

parts.note: the Plough is the group of stars in the Great Bear constellation

explanation.surface: A bear is discovered without a head in a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: The Plough is the British name for the Big Dipper, part of the Great Bear; LOUGH is an Irish lake.
explanation.definitionFit: An Irish word for a lake or sea inlet, so a body of water.

clue.text: Drink in support of ball game

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece in support of another sits beneath it

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance, as is a ball
Scotch is whisky, a drink

explanation.surface: Having a drink while supporting a ball game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ball' looks like a sports ball but is a dance (HOP); 'in support of' puts SCOTCH under it.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's playground pastime of hopping between chalked squares.

clue.text: Able to rise with credit in fresh situation

indicators.note: in places the word for credit inside the fresh situation

parts.note: an airy place is fresh and breezy
worth is merit or standing, credit

explanation.surface: Someone is fit to be promoted, given credit in a new post.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft certified fit to fly is capable of taking to the sky.

clue.text: Flyer from the Russian front

parts.note: Red refers to a Communist, especially Soviet Russian
the breast is the front of the chest

explanation.surface: An airman coming from the Soviet battle front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flyer' suggests a pilot, but it is a bird: the robin.
explanation.definitionFit: The robin is a small bird, so it is a creature of the air.

clue.text: Scope of paper on lace development

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece on another sits above it

parts.note: The Times is a newspaper

indicators.note: development means the letters of lace are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A newspaper's range of coverage of the lace industry's progress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'paper' is the British newspaper of that name; in a down answer 'on' puts it above the rearranged lace, with 'development' as the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A period or span over which something happens defines its extent.

clue.text: Where flowers may be displayed for overall cover

definitions.meaning: a flower ... out is where blooms are shown
a coverlet placed over the whole bed

explanation.definitionFit: A decorative top layer laid over a bed, and a laid-out patch of garden for blooms.

clue.text: Told to clothe old bird in woven silk

indicators.note: to clothe means to wrap around, so the bird sits inside the word for told

parts.note: bade is the past tense of bid, to tell or order
the roc is a giant mythical bird of old legend

explanation.surface: Instructed to dress an elderly bird in rich fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: A rich fabric with raised patterns, traditionally of silk, woven on a loom.

clue.text: Tidy unlike Brooke's unofficial rose

definitions.meaning: Rupert Brooke's poem about Grantchester has an English unofficial rose blowing unkempt about the hedges

explanation.walkthrough: Rupert Brooke was an English poet; his Grantchester poem speaks of the unofficial rose as 'unkempt', so its opposite is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatly kept and groomed, the opposite of the dishevelled wild rose in the poem.

clue.text: Note on a church: 'Popular series of lectures'

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A notice on a church announces a well-attended lecture series.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Popular' looks like part of the definition but supplies IN.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal session of talks and discussion, often on a political issue, at a college.

clue.text: Soft in the context of the ear or the eye

indicators.note: in the context of places the soft letter inside the word for the ear

parts.note: otic means relating to the ear
p is piano, the musical direction for soft

explanation.surface: A medical note on softness in hearing or sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to sight or vision, and jocularly used to mean the organ of sight.

clue.text: Doctor out moving House

indicators.note: moving means the letters are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A physician leaves when relocating home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges DR and OUT; House is a royal dynasty, not a home.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal dynasty of England, which included Henry VIII and Elizabeth I.

clue.text: English barges in trouble waters .

indicators.note: in trouble suggests something upset, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: English boats get into difficulty out at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A northern part of the Pacific between Alaska and Siberia is a stretch of sea.

clue.text: Expression of doubt about the service is overdone

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the expression of doubt goes round the service

parts.note: but is said when raising a doubt or objection
RN is the Royal Navy, the senior service

explanation.surface: A doubtful remark about whether the service has gone on too long.
explanation.definitionFit: Food cooked too long gets scorched and charred.

clue.text: Look after Florence for one?

definitions.meaning: Florence Nightingale is the famous example of a carer of the sick

explanation.definitionFit: To care for the sick, and Florence Nightingale was the most famous hospital carer.

clue.text: Theatres set up by accountant initially in America

parts.note: an auditor is an accountant who checks the books

indicators.note: initially takes the first letters of the words in and America

explanation.surface: Playhouses built by a US-based accountant.
explanation.definitionFit: Halls or auditorium spaces where audiences watch plays.

clue.text: Get to a place along the river

definitions.meaning: a stretch of river between two bends

explanation.definitionFit: To arrive at somewhere, and a straight stretch of a waterway.

clue.text: Close range evidence of being talked about

definitions.meaning: folk lore says your ears burn and feel hot when someone is gossiping about you

explanation.walkthrough: Split it as EARS HOT: the old saying is that your ears burn when others discuss you.
explanation.definitionFit: The distance within which a voice can be heard, and hot ears as a sign of being gossiped about.

clue.text: In that regard check following' article

indicators.note: following means the word for check comes after the article

parts.note: the is the definite article
to rein is to check or restrain

explanation.surface: Examine the following article for its relevance.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal adverb meaning in that place or in that respect.
